courses.title: Project Development for Nonprofit Leaders
courses.description: Project Development for Nonprofit Leaders takes you from the basics of project development to applying it on a realistic Executive Director scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to leadership, enough to use it alongside project development day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying project development to a real Executive Director scenario
Practicing project development through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to leadership
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Fundraising and Grant Writing in Practice
courses.description: Fundraising and Grant Writing in Practice goes beyond the basics of fundraising and grant writing, for people already working toward a Executive Director role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in fundraising and grant writing and want to go further.
